line: Man, I’m the energizer Bunny, call me Bugs Bunny, eh what’s up doc?
meaning:
Energizer is a battery company known for the bunny in its ads.

By calling himself the “energizer”, Keef is the main leader who will motivate his gang. Since Energizer has a bunny rabbit in its ads, he also calls himself Bugs Bunny, an old cartoon character. One of Bugs’s famous lines is:

What’s up doc?

He usually says this right after the hunter fails to catch him. While having a smirk on his face, Bugs nonchalantly eats a carrot and smiles at the hunter.

Hailing from the violent South Side of Chicago, people would try to hunt Sosa all the time, but he is always one step ahead and outsmarts them like Bugs Bunny does with the hunter.
